Maya (CS Ops): quick sync  we need an enablement webhook to auto-log training completions + optionally bump healthscore.
Diego (Eng Backend): ok — endpoint on ops-api? /webhooks/enablement?
Maya (CS Ops): yes. required: account_id, training_id, nps, feedback. optional: training_version, instructor_name.
Mina (Product): product asks to track curriculum_tag and training_version so we can correlate with retention.
Sam (CS Manager): health bump should be soft-gated: tag enablement.received and queue +10 after 14d unless churn flags seen. Backfill last 90 days please.
Diego (Eng Backend): design notes: HMAC header X-RW-Signature, X-RW-Idempotency. idempotency = sha256(account_id+training_id+event_ts). retry policy 3 attempts exp backoff. support rotating secrets with X-RW-Signature-V2.
Maya (CS Ops): when received create CRM activity "Enablement: completion" with feedback in note and who submitted. If account.opt_out in [legal,privacy] then log only.
Diego (Eng Backend): will write backfill admin route `/admin/backfill/enablement?days=90&dry_run=true` that exports CSV with account_id, owner_id, owner_email, received_ts, nps, opt_out.
Mina (Product): add feature-flag `ff.enable_enablement_immediate` for a canary org (654321) to apply score immediately. metrics: NPS dist, renewal_risk delta 30/90d.
Diego (Eng Backend): timeline: PR by Thu EOD, dry-run backfill Fri, canary next Tue for 7-day watch, full rollout after. will include sample webhook and HMAC verification snippet.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-1987: Enablement webhook + backfill (assignee Diego).
Maya (CS Ops): I'll prep owners CSV and opt-out list. Please drop PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
